sections.title: Objective and Scope
paragraphs: This Leave Policy outlines the various types of leave available to Cotelligent associates, the entitlement for each leave type, and the procedure for applying and availing leave. This policy is applicable to all full-time permanent employees of Cotelligent.

sections.title: Earned Leave (EL)
paragraphs: All full-time permanent employees are entitled to 15 Earned Leave (EL) days per calendar year. EL is accrued at the rate of 1.25 days per month. EL can be accrued and carried forward up to a maximum of 30 days across years.

Earned Leave can be availed for personal reasons, vacation, or any other purpose at the employee's discretion with prior manager approval. EL must be applied for in advance and approved in ZOHO before availing.
EL encashment is permitted up to a maximum of 15 days per year during the annual leave encashment cycle. Encashment is processed at the basic salary rate.

sections.title: Sick Leave (SL)
paragraphs: All full-time permanent employees are entitled to 7 Sick Leave (SL) days per calendar year. SL is credited at the beginning of the year and is non-accruing (unused SL lapses at year end).

Sick Leave can be availed for personal illness or medical treatment. For SL exceeding 3 consecutive days, a medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner must be submitted to HR. SL is to be applied on the same day or the next working day upon return in ZOHO.
Sick Leave cannot be carried forward or encashed.

sections.title: Casual Leave (CL)
paragraphs: Associates are entitled to Casual Leave as per applicable state labour laws. CL is meant for unforeseen or urgent personal requirements. CL cannot be taken for more than 3 consecutive days and cannot be combined with Earned Leave.
CL must be applied for in ZOHO. CL cannot be carried forward or encashed at year end.

sections.title: Public Holidays
paragraphs: Cotelligent observes a fixed list of public holidays each year as communicated by the HR department at the start of the year. The holiday list is posted on the company intranet and ZOHO.
Associates working on a public holiday are eligible for Compensatory Off (Comp-off) as per the Comp-off policy, or may receive extra pay as per applicable project agreements.

sections.title: Leave Application Procedure
paragraphs: All leave must be applied for and approved through the ZOHO People HR system. Associates must apply for planned leave (EL) at least 3 days in advance. For emergency or unplanned leave, the associate must inform the reporting manager by phone or message and apply in ZOHO on the same day or the next working day.

Leave is approved at the discretion of the reporting manager. Approval depends on business requirements, project deadlines, and team coverage. Unapproved leave will be treated as leave without pay (LWP) or absence as applicable.

sections.title: Leave Without Pay (LWP)
paragraphs: Leave Without Pay (LWP) is granted at the management's discretion when an associate has exhausted all leave balances. LWP results in a salary deduction for the days not worked.
Associates must request LWP in advance through ZOHO and obtain manager and HR approval. Unauthorized absence will also be treated as LWP and may result in disciplinary action.

sections.title: Half-Day Leave
paragraphs: Associates can apply for half-day leave through ZOHO. A half-day leave deducts 0.5 days from the respective leave balance. Associates applying for half-day leave on a day they are on night shift allowance should note that Night Shift Allowance is NOT payable on days when half-day leave is applied.
